Hi Markus,

I downloaded your benchmark PDF this morning (great work — thanks!). I'm on the infrastructure team at DataLoom and we’re evaluating inference platforms for a small pilot. A short demo to understand latency profiles and deployment options would be really helpful.

Rough ask: 20–30 minutes to see Hosted API performance, a quick peek at Dedicated capacity options, and how rollouts work. I’m in PST (San Francisco). Our tentative timeline is a pilot in late Q1.

Are you available early next week? I can do Monday or Tuesday afternoons (PST). If it's easier, send a Calendly link and I'll pick a time.

Thanks —

Hi Sana — great to hear from you and glad the benchmark was useful. Priyom (cc'ed) is our SDR who coordinates demos; I’ll run the technical portion.

We can absolutely do 20–30 minutes to cover Hosted API latency, Dedicated capacity sizing, and rollout tooling. Two immediate options:
- Mon Jan 11, 11:30am–12:00pm PST
- Tue Jan 12, 2:00pm–2:30pm PST

Or feel free to pick any slot on this link: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30

I attached a one-page "Redwood Quick Prep" that lists what we typically cover and a short copy of the benchmark summary so you have it in your calendar. If there are specific numbers or workloads you want us to run in the session, include them in your reply and we’ll aim to surface them.

We'd like to focus on a small production-ish scenario: 1) 2–4 concurrent sustained requests, 2) typical sequence length ~1k tokens, and 3) basic security controls for VPC/private deployment. I've attached a short internal note that gives context on our pilot so you can tailor the demo.

Prep: please open the attached "Redwood-Quick-Prep.pdf" before the call. If you want specific model flavors or sequence lengths exercised, email them to me and we'll run them in the demo.
